text: You're looking for a quick and flavorful dish that fits your dietary needs. I think the Spicy Dill Rice recipe is a great match. It's made with basmati rice, which is a good source of complex carbohydrates, and paired with chicken stock for added protein. The addition of dill and jalapeno gives it a nice flavor boost without adding any dairy. The recipe is also relatively low in sugar and can be prepared in under 30 minutes, which fits your time budget. Overall, it's a nutritious and satisfying option that should meet your requirements.
